Mei Huang  
📍 Berlin, Germany | 📧 mei.huang@email.com | 📞 +49 123 456 789 | 🌐 linkedin.com/in/mei-huang  

A collaborative full-stack developer with a focus on scalable e-commerce solutions. Specializes in building intuitive user interfaces and robust backend systems, with a track record of improving operational efficiency through technical innovation. Committed to continuous learning and contributing to high-impact projects in dynamic tech environments.  

**Technical Skills**

- **Frontend Development**: React (component-based UI for product dashboards), TypeScript (type-safe codebase for order management systems)  
- **Tools & Frameworks**: Vue.js (single-page application for customer accounts), Docker (containerization for local development environments)  
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS S3 integration for media storage, basic CI/CD pipeline configuration using GitHub Actions  
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL (query optimization for real-time analytics), MongoDB (prototype for user behavior logging in a side project)
